Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Procurement of M.S. pipe (Seamless) for new sinking and regular maintenance of big dia. tube wells under water supply department. 1) The FINANCIAL OFFER of the prospective participant in the tender will be consi dered only if the TECHNICAL DOCUMENTS of the participant in the tender is fo und qualified by the KMC authority. The decision of the KMC Authority will be fina l and absolute in this respect. The list of Qualified Bidders will be displayed in the website. For any queries regarding this tender, contact Sri Swapan Sikdar, A.C.S., Supply De partment, Mobile No: 8981129220 2) Terms and conditions for participation in the tender. I. All intending participant in the tender who qualifies in the eligibility cr iteria for the purpose of M.S. Pipe (Seamless) should also fulfill the followi ng additional requirements. If any of the participants in the tender fails t o fulfill any of the terms & conditions mentioned below, that particular te nder will be declared informal/non-responsive. II. Certificate to ensure that the pipe manufacturing capacity of the fact ory is sufficient to cater to the tendered requirement i.e. capacity should

not be less than the tendered quantity. III. Manufacturers should furnish satisfactory test report of M.S. pipes (Se amless) from reputed Govt. institutions/ Universities. IV. Length of each pipe should be 6 Mtr. (Tolerance shall be as per ASTM standard) v. Manufacturer should produce Factory License as well as valid enlistmen t with Engineers India Limited as on date of publication of tender for eac h and individual size of pipe tendered. If the participant is a reseller, submission of authorization letter to participate in this tender a s well as required certificates and performance documents from principal manufacturer is mandatory. vi. Manufacturers (Participant in the tender) should produce valid PAN issue d by the IT Department, Govt. of India. 15 digits Goods & Services Tax Id entification Number (GSTIN) under GST Act 2007, Latest P.Tax. deposit challan & Certificate, ITR & Balance sheet for the last 2 F/Y. vii. For Partnership firm Partnership deed and power of attorney are to be submitted. viii. Trade license will be mandatory for those whose manufacturing unit is lo cated within the jurisdiction of KMC. ix. Signed copy of ATC is to be mandatorily uploaded as a testimony of acceptance of all terms & conditions put up in the Bid document. x. Bank solvency certificate from any schedule Bank not older than one (1) year and should be minimum of 40% of the amount put to tender or latest statement of balance in account as desired to fulfill the requirement. xi. Third party inspection (TPI) through RITES/MECON/EIL/PDIL of pipe is man datory before delivery of pipe. All the parameters should be as per AST M standards. xii. The inspection charges are to be included in the quoted rate. xiii. a) Intending tenderers should produce credentials of a similar nature of com pleted work of the minimum value of 30% (Thirty percent) of the estimat ed amount put to tender during 5(five) years prior to the date of issue of the tender notice; Or, b)Intending tenderers should produce credentials of 2(two) similar nature of c ompleted work, each of the minimum value of 25% (Twenty five percent) of the est imated amount put to tender during 5(five) years prior to the date of issue of the ten der notice; Or, c)Intending tenderers should produce credentials of one single running work of similar nature which has been completed to the extent of 75% (Seventy fiv e percent) or more and value of which is not less than the desired value at (a) abov e; xiv. In case of running works, only those bidders who will submit the certificate of s atisfactory running work from the concerned Executive Engineer, or equivalent co mpetent authority will be eligible for the tender. In the required certificate it shoul d be clearly stated that the work is in progress satisfactorily and also that no pen al action has been initiated against the executing agency, i.e., the bidder.

xv. Similar nature of work includes supply ofM S Seamless pipe/spirally welded MS pip e/ERW MS pipe/DI pipe. xvi. Credential certificate issued by Executive engineer or equivalent or competent au thority of a State/Central Government, State/Central Government undertaking, St atutory/Autonomous bodies constituted under the Central/State statute, on the e xecuted value of completed/running work will be taken as credential. xvii. Payment Certificate will not be treated as credential; 3) A declaration in the form of an affidavit on stamp paper of Rs. 10/-, duly atte sted by a Notary should be submitted as per format given in the Proforma I, stating that the applicant is not debarred or blacklisted in any way at any Govt./S emi- Govt. /Autonomous Body/ institution in India at the time of submission of the tender. 4) The eligibility of a bidder will be ascertained on the basis of the document(s) in s upport of the eligibility criteria as mentioned in Clause 2 & 3 above. If any docum ent submitted by a bidder is either manufactured or false, in such cases the eligi bility of the bidder / participant in the tender will be rejected at any stage without any prejudice. In that case security deposit submitted by the bidder will be forfeit ed and the bidder may be debarred from participating in any tender by Kolkata M unicipal Corporation in future. 5) Payment will be made as per GeM. 6) Whenever the contracts are rescinded the security deposits shall be forfeited. 7) The successful bidder will have to provide security deposit, worth 5% as per GEM. 8) The price preference will be governed by the notification vide no. 10500-F of Wes t Bengal Financial Rule (WBFR) issued by Govt. of West Bengal Finance Departm ent, Audit Branch. 9) Offer shall remain valid for a period of 365 days from the date of opening of tend er for acceptance. Once accepted, the offer should remain valid for full financial y ear or 365 days from the date of opening of tender whichever is later. If the bidd er withdraws the bid during the validity period of bid, the security deposit as dep osited will be forfeited forthwith without assigning any reason thereof. 10) Bidders will have to offer rate w.r.t. each individual item. Lowest bidder w.r.t. eac h individual item will be considered. 11) Supply must strictly be completed within the delivery period mentioned in th e purchase order failing which order may be cancelled and the Department may ta ke appropriate action as per GeM guidelines. 12) If any material is found defective after supply, the same is to be replaced free of cost. 13) There shall be no provision of Arbitration. 14) Pre-bid meeting will be conducted on 18.11.26 at 2PM in the chamber of Controller of Stores & Purchase at the scheduled date and all the interested participants are requested t o attend the meeting for any query or information. If any major query/information is there t his is to be submitted in writing during pre-bid meeting.

15) The intending Bidders should clearly understand that whatever may be the ouctome of the present invitation of Bids, no cost of Bidding shall be reimbursable by the Department. T he KMC authority reserves the right to accept or reject any offer without assigning any reas on whatsoever and is not liable for any cost that might have been incurred by any Participa nt in the tender at the stage of Bidding. 16) Conditional / Incomplete tender will not be accepted under any circumstances. 17) The appropriate authority of Kolkata Municipal Corporation, reserves the right to c ancel the tender due to unavoidable circumstances and no claim in this respect will be ente rtained. KMC also reserves the right to invite tender afresh with modified eligibility criteria. 18) Quoted price should include all statutory payments imposed by State & Centra l Govt. Escalation of Price on any ground and consequent cost overrun shall not be e ntertained under any circumstances. Rates should be quoted accordingly. The bidd er has to submit the breakups if asked for. 19) If the dates fall on holidays or natural calamity, the dates defer to next worki ng days. 20) KMC reserves the right to award the contract part or full or to cancel the contr act without assigning any reason thereof. 21) The bidders may be required to supply 25% more or less of the contracted qu antity at the contracted rates, at any time during the contract period includin g the extended time. 22) The bidders should follow the GeM portal for any corrigendum published by th e authority before opening of the tender.
